old.name: Linđo Folklore Ensemble — Lazareti
old.label: FOLK
old.hook: Live Linđo with lijerica all summer · UNESCO-related Konavle circle dance
old.text: Live Linđo with lijerica all summer · UNESCO-related Konavle circle dance The Konavle circle dance: a dance-master sits and plays the lijerica — a three-string lyre held on the knee — while calling rhymed commands and stamping rhythm with his right foot . The dancers form a wheel around him. Croatia's UNESCO ICH listed dance traditions. The Linđo Folklore Ensemble performs three times a week at Lazareti (the former 16th-c. plague quarantine, now a cultural centre) just outside Ploče Gate, from late May through early October. Where Lazareti (just outside Ploče Gate)

old.name: Oliver Dragojević — "Cesarica"
old.label: DALMATIAN VOICE
old.hook: The Dalmatian voice — "Cesarica" (1993, written by Gibonni) is the regional anthem
old.text: The Dalmatian voice — "Cesarica" (1993, written by Gibonni) is the regional anthem The defining post-war voice of Dalmatia. Born in Vela Luka on Korčula in 1947, died 29 July 2018. The funeral procession from Split to Vela Luka was hundreds of boats. "Cesarica" (1993, written for Oliver by Gibonni) is the song every Dalmatian knows from the first three bars. Albums to queue while prepping service: Vridilo je (2009), Pjesma o ljubavi , anything from the 1980s with the brass section. Klapa-rooted but with a smoky jazz shadow. Where Vela Luka, Korčula (b. 7 Dec 1947 – d. 29 Jul 2018)

old.name: Gibonni — 43 Porin awards
old.label: RECORD-HOLDER
old.hook: Klapa-rooted pop · wrote Cesarica for Oliver · the most-awarded Croatian artist
old.text: Klapa-rooted pop · wrote Cesarica for Oliver · the most-awarded Croatian artist Zlatan Stipišić Gibonni, born Split 13 August 1968. Croatia's most-awarded artist with 43 Porin awards . Songwriter and singer; the bridge between klapa tradition and modern pop. Tracks worth queuing: "Libar" , "Činim pravu stvar" , "Tek je 12 sati" . He wrote Cesarica for Oliver in 1993 — the two names anchor any Dalmatian playlist. Live at the Pula Arena every summer; check the Dubrovnik Summer Festival for an occasional appearance. Where Split (b. 13 Aug 1968)

old.name: Klapa Cambi — five-time Omiš gold
old.label: KLAPA
old.hook: Modern klapa at its tightest · UNESCO ICH 2012
old.text: Modern klapa at its tightest · UNESCO ICH 2012 Klapa is Dalmatian a cappella multipart singing — four to ten male singers in a tight semicircle, first tenor leads, the others stack chords below. UNESCO ICH listed in 2012. Klapa Cambi from Split are five-time gold medalists at the Omiš Festival of Dalmatian Klapa Songs — the national competition. Defining track "Moj lipi anđele" . Also queue: Klapa Iskon ( "Dobra večer prijatelji" ), Klapa Maslina. Where Split-based klapa

old.name: Cavtat harbour + Račić mausoleum
old.text: 17 km south of Dubrovnik (tender 40 min or car 30 min). Walk the harbour past the Vlaho Bukovac House (1855–1922 painter, born here) to the Mestrović-built Račić Mausoleum on the cemetery peninsula — Ivan Meštrović 1922, full white marble. Stop at Galerija Vlaho Bukovac (EUR 6) on the way back. Konoba Galija for the dinner.

around:Cavtat.brief: The Račić mausoleum is by Ivan Meštrović (1920-22); Vlaho Bukovac's house; the boat from the Old Port (season); the old text names 'Konoba Galija' for dinner — it is NOT a kept venue: do not recommend it.

old.name: Sokol Grad — the Konavle falcon fortress
old.label: GEM
old.text: First mentioned 1373; gifted to the Republic in 1391 by the Sanković family; abandoned after a 1672 earthquake; restored in 2013 . The largest Republic fortress outside the city. Perched on a 25 m vertical rock above Dunave village, 40 min south of Dubrovnik. Tiny museum inside; nearly always empty. EUR 8. Combine with lunch at Konavoski Dvori 30 min away. Where Dunave village · Konavle When Apr–Oct 10:00–19:00 / Nov–Mar 10:00–14:00
